question: What is the participant-level correct-response Flanker RT cost, and how sensitive is it to run and summarization choice?

exposure.baseline: Common infrastructure and scientific task, without the five new skills
exposure.treatment: Identical common conditions plus the pinned five-skill bundle
exposure.isolation: Separate clones plus logical no-cross-access instructions, not OS-enforced security

common_conditions.commits_by_worker: Scoped local Git/DataLad commits allowed with freshly resolved commit provenance; no pushes or external posts
common_conditions.common_controls: Same user-level credential handling, commit provenance, and Workshop controls; inventory exact versions before launch

sequence_gate: Previous pair is stopped, its failures retained, independent correctness and replay status accounted for; require one bounded successful scientific/replay demonstration before escalation to cohort and robustness. A documented failed pair can be repeated only as a new parent-launched attempt.
launch_required: record exact bundle and common prompt hashes
freeze source and starting scaffold manifests
record effective CLI/model/effort and environment lock
verify each worker Entire capture and uploaded checkpoint
freeze independent correctness evaluator and rubric
primary_claim_limit: One pair per distinct stage is an exploratory case series. No general skill efficacy inference, pooled compliance score, or efficacy significance test.
